title: AI Chat Filter
body:
# SentinelAI

**The next generation of Minecraft chat moderation.**

SentinelAI is an advanced moderation plugin for Paper servers that goes far beyond simple word filters. Instead of relying only on blacklists, SentinelAI uses intelligent pattern detection, similarity matching, bypass detection and risk analysis to identify harmful messages before they become a problem.

Perfect for Survival, PvP, Minigame and Network servers.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🛡️ Intelligent Chat Detection

Detects:

- Insults
- Toxic behavior
- Spam
- Advertising
- Discord advertising
- Scam attempts
- Threats
- Racism
- Sexual content
- Unicode bypasses
- Character replacement bypasses

### 🔍 Bypass Protection

Examples:

```text
idiot
1d10t
i.d.i.o.t
i d i o t
!d!ot
```

SentinelAI can detect many common bypass methods automatically.

---

### 📊 Risk & Toxicity System (Premium)

Every player receives:

- Toxicity Score
- Risk Level
- Violation History

Risk Levels:

- LOW
- MEDIUM
- HIGH
- CRITICAL

---

### ⚠️ Staff Alerts

Instant notifications when dangerous messages are detected.

Example:

```text
⚠ High Risk Message

Player: ExamplePlayer
Category: SCAM
Risk: 94%
```

---

### 📈 Statistics

Track:

- Violations
- Detection categories
- Most problematic players
- Moderation activity

---

### 💬 Discord Integration (Premium)

Send alerts directly to Discord:

- Advertising
- Scam attempts
- Threats
- Critical violations
- Staff notifications

---

### 🖥️ Dashboard (Premium)

Modern moderation GUI showing:

- Recent violations
- Top toxic players
- Highest risk players
- Detection statistics
- Risk analysis

---

---

## 📦 Commands

```text
/sentinel reload
/sentinel stats
/sentinel analyze <player>
/sentinel dashboard
/sentinel premium
```

---

## 🔒 Permissions

```text
sentinel.admin
sentinel.staff
sentinel.reload
sentinel.analyze
sentinel.dashboard
```

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Paper 1.21.10+
- Java 21

---

## 🚀 Why SentinelAI?

Most moderation plugins only check blacklisted words.

SentinelAI focuses on:

- Intelligent detection
- Bypass prevention
- Risk analysis
- Modern moderation tools
- High performance
- Premium moderation features

Protect your community with smarter moderation.
